chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān and Khalaf ibn Ḥammād, from al-Fuḍayl ibn Yasār and Ribʿī ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, concerning:
Regarding a man who has intercourse with a beast, he عليه السلام said: “There is no fixed hadd punishment upon him, but he is to be beaten as taʿzīr.”

key_terms.الْبَهِيمَةِ: a beast or animal with which the prohibited act is committed
key_terms.تَعْزِيرًا: a discretionary disciplinary punishment determined by authority
key_terms.حَدٌّ: a fixed, prescribed legal punishment in the Sacred Law
key_terms.يُضْرَبُ: he is to be beaten or struck as punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a man who has intercourse with an animal in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a man who commits an act with an animal. It states that the fixed hadd punishment does not apply in this case, but a discretionary disciplinary punishment (taʿzīr) is to be administered.
